headline: Stott, Harper power Phillies past D-backs, win 5th straight
recap: The Phillies beat the Diamondbacks 2-1 in Phoenix on Monday, extending their winning streak to five games. Garrett Stubbs scored in the second inning on a Bryce Harper RBI double, and Bryson Stott added a solo home run in the third to make it 2-0 before Arizona answered with a Gabriel Moreno RBI double later in the inning. Aaron Nola picked up the win, allowing one run over five innings with four strikeouts, and Alex McFarlane, Orion Kerkering, Brooks Raley and Jose Alvarado combined for three scoreless innings before Jhoan Duran closed it out for his 29th save. Arizona starter Brandon Pfaadt took the loss despite going six innings, and the Diamondbacks outhit Philadelphia 9-6 but could not push across a second run.
Philadelphia is 78-60 and holds second place in the NL East, four games behind the division-leading Braves, riding a five-game winning streak.
The Phillies continue their series against the Diamondbacks at Chase Field on Tuesday night, with Jesus Luzardo starting opposite Eduardo Rodriguez. First pitch is scheduled for 9:40 PM ET.
